statement: The United States conducts at least one military strike on Iranian territory between 2026-07-28 and 2026-08-14.
resolution: Resolved yes if US Central Command or the Department of Defense confirms a strike on Iranian territory in that window, or if two or more of AP, Reuters and AFP report one.

statement: The upper bound of the US federal funds target range is above 3.75 percent on 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved from the FOMC implementation note in effect on 2026-10-30. Yes if the upper bound of the target range exceeds 3.75 percent on that date.

statement: ICE Brent front-month crude futures settle below 85.00 US dollars per barrel on 2026-08-28.
resolution: Resolved from the official ICE settlement price for the front-month Brent contract on 2026-08-28. Yes if that settlement is below 85.00 US dollars.

statement: CISA adds a vulnerability in the n8n workflow automation platform to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog between 2026-07-28 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: Resolved from the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 2026-10-30. Yes if any entry naming n8n carries a date-added inside the window.

statement: OpenAI publishes a public incident report or postmortem covering the agent-related compromise reported on 2026-07-27, on or before 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved by checking the OpenAI official blog and security pages on 2026-09-30. Yes if a dated public writeup of that specific incident is present.

statement: Labour leads Reform UK in at least two nationally published Great Britain voting-intention polls fielded entirely within September 2026.
resolution: Resolved on 2026-10-05 from the Wikipedia opinion polling page for the next UK general election. Yes if two or more qualifying September polls show a Labour lead.

statement: The German federal government formally introduces draft legislation tightening extremism or hate-crime law in the Bundestag between 2026-07-28 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: Resolved from the Bundestag document register on 2026-11-30. Yes if a government bill on extremism or hate-crime law is registered inside the window.

statement: A Meteo-France station records a maximum air temperature of 45.0 degrees Celsius or higher in metropolitan France between 2026-07-28 and 2026-09-15.
resolution: Resolved from Meteo-France published observations on 2026-09-15. Yes if any metropolitan station reports a daily maximum of 45.0 degrees Celsius or above.

statement: At least one person is formally charged with a homicide offense in connection with the 2026-07-26 Seattle festival shooting, on or before 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved from King County Prosecuting Attorney charging documents or two major wire reports as of 2026-09-30. Yes if any homicide charge has been filed.

statement: CXMT shares close below their first-trading-day closing price on 2026-09-30.
resolution: Resolved from the listing exchange official closing price on 2026-09-30 compared with the first-trading-day close. Yes if the 2026-09-30 close is lower.
